cms_event.description: Calendar events attached to CMS nodes; several events may refer to the same node.

start.description: ISO date for an all-day event, otherwise an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp.

end.description: Exclusive end, in the same form as start.

rrule.description: RFC 5545 recurrence rule; empty for a fixed event.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone preserving the local start time of recurring timed events.

rdate.description: Additional recurrence starts, in the same date type as start.

exdate.description: Excluded recurrence starts, in the same date type as start.
